agency: Miami-Dade Department of Regulatory and Economic Resources (RER) — Consumer and Neighborhood Protection Division
credential_primary_name: Moving Business Registration / Moving Business License (MR-#####)
ordinance: Article XVI, Chapter 8A (Moving Ordinance) of Miami-Dade County Code
geographic_scope: Local moves within Miami-Dade County; tri-county South Florida disclosure practices documented with Palm Beach / Broward programs
application_collects: owners/officers (including DOB — do not commit personal IDs)
insurance certificates (GL any; Auto liability min $50k/<35k GVW or $100k/>35k; Cargo $10k)
complaints_channel: Consumer Mediation Center — intake; no public structured business complaint history found
civil_citations: Authority documented; no public bulk citation roster found
grandfathered_local_authority: Consistent with Fla. Stat. §507.13 grandfathering of pre-2011 local mover ordinances (documented in FL-C001); Miami-Dade continues Moving Ordinance program as of 2026 materials.
